column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 21 (E99003): 16Lab memasok Frame & perbekalan diam-diam,
# Persica menyembunyikan jejak Kalina, lalu Asteria meminta dukungan.
# Tetap Inggris: 16Lab, Persicaria, Persica, Lainie, Leva, Underground Broker, Poludnitsa,
# Commander, Mokosh, The Elmo, White Zone, Yellow Zone, Green Zone, Nele, Squad 404,
# AR Team, Kalina, Frame, Alva, Caramel Hazelnut Coffee, Griffin, URNC, Leibnys, Kryuger,
# ST AR-15, Soppo, Robella, Paradeus, Chiloveig, Ateraxis, M16, Asteria, Doll, Sugar Cube.
(16Lab, Persicaria's laboratory was unusually quiet. The researchers who usually bustled about had all been temporarily ordered by Persica to stop working and return home.)
column2: (16Lab, laboratorium Persicaria luar biasa sunyi. Para peneliti yang biasanya sibuk hilir-mudik semuanya sementara diperintahkan Persica berhenti bekerja dan pulang.)

column1: (On the giant screen in the main control room, countless data streams cascaded like a waterfall. Lainie stood in front of the console, her fingers flying across the virtual keyboard, archiving the final supply lists.)
column2: (Di layar raksasa ruang kendali utama, arus data yang tak terhitung mengalir turun seperti air terjun. Lainie berdiri di depan konsol, jarinya melesat di papan ketik virtual, mengarsipkan daftar pasokan terakhir.)

column1: The additional goods have all been loaded. When you and the others, Leva, arrive at the next contact point, you can receive them directly.
column2: Barang tambahannya sudah dimuat semua. Saat kau dan yang lain sampai di titik kontak berikutnya, Leva, kalian bisa langsung menerimanya.

column1: The contact person for this batch of goods is an Underground Broker named Poludnitsa. Leva, you guys should know her too, right? She seems to have some connection with the Commander as well.
column2: Penghubung untuk kiriman ini adalah Underground Broker bernama Poludnitsa. Leva, kalian juga mengenalnya, kan? Sepertinya dia juga punya kaitan dengan Commander.

column1: Yeah, we've dealt with her before. At the very least, she's a merchant who values her reputation.
column2: Iya, kami pernah berurusan dengannya. Setidaknya dia pedagang yang menjaga reputasinya.

column1: Thanks for your hard work, Lainie.
column2: Terima kasih atas kerja kerasmu, Lainie.

column1: This kind of resource allocation work is nothing for a Doll's processing power.
column2: Pekerjaan alokasi sumber daya seperti ini bukan apa-apa untuk daya proses seorang Doll.

column1: Compared to this... are you really not going to let me go to Mokosh with you?
column2: Dibanding itu... kalian benar-benar tidak mengizinkanku ikut ke Mokosh?

column1: My new frame has been completely adjusted, and all parameters meet the standards. There's absolutely no problem with me serving as direct combat power.
column2: Frame baruku sudah disetel sepenuhnya, dan semua parameternya memenuhi standar. Sama sekali tidak masalah kalau aku jadi kekuatan tempur langsung.

column1: Alright, now we need someone to stay in the absolutely safe rear to provide us with stable intelligence relay and logistical support.
column2: Sudah, sekarang kami butuh seseorang yang tinggal di belakang yang benar-benar aman untuk memberi kami relai intel dan dukungan logistik yang stabil.

column1: And more importantly, we need someone trustworthy enough to stay behind and protect Persica.
column2: Dan yang lebih penting, kami butuh orang yang cukup bisa dipercaya untuk tinggal dan melindungi Persica.

column1: But I already greeted the Commander before, and yet I still haven't been able to officially report to The Elmo. I just feel a bit unwilling.
column2: Tapi aku sudah pernah menyapa Commander, dan sampai sekarang belum bisa resmi lapor ke The Elmo. Aku merasa agak tidak rela.

column1: Securing the rear is also an important part of combat.
column2: Mengamankan bagian belakang juga bagian penting dari pertempuran.

column1: Don't worry, Leva and I will work hard for your share too.
column2: Jangan khawatir, aku dan Leva akan bekerja keras untuk bagianmu juga.

column1: Although I don't think those people will make a move in the White Zone, it's never wrong to have an extra backup plan.
column2: Meski kurasa orang-orang itu tidak akan bergerak di White Zone, punya satu rencana cadangan tambahan tidak pernah salah.

column1: And Nele needs manpower over there too, so you just stay by our side on standby for now.
column2: Dan Nele di sana juga butuh tenaga, jadi kau tetap di sisi kami dan bersiaga dulu.

column1: Once the dust settles in the Yellow Zone, we might still need your help transporting supplies.
column2: Begitu debu di Yellow Zone mereda, kami mungkin masih butuh bantuanmu mengangkut pasokan.

column1: (Persica moved her gaze away from the screen full of data and lazily picked up a cup of coffee. She rubbed her signature messy hair, seeming a bit tired.)
column2: (Persica mengalihkan tatapannya dari layar penuh data dan malas-malasan mengambil secangkir kopi. Dia mengusap rambut berantakan khasnya, tampak agak lelah.)

column1: As for Squad 404 and the AR Team... you need to protect Kalina, and try not to break your Frames as much as possible.
column2: Soal Squad 404 dan AR Team... kalian harus melindungi Kalina, dan usahakan sebisa mungkin tidak merusak Frame kalian.

column1: Oh right... almost forgot about the Commander, protect him while you're at it.
column2: Oh iya... hampir lupa soal Commander, lindungi dia sekalian.

column1: Hehehe, just while I'm at it?
column2: Hehehe, cuma sekalian?

column1: Yeah, I'll take out all the bad guys.
column2: Iya, akan kuhabisi semua orang jahatnya.

column1: You didn't listen to a single word about not breaking the Frame, did you.
column2: Soal jangan merusak Frame itu sama sekali tidak kau dengarkan, ya.

column1: Persica, thank you for your generous help. With this batch of Frames and equipment, we can definitely solve the Commander's urgent needs.
column2: Persica, terima kasih atas bantuanmu yang murah hati. Dengan kiriman Frame dan perlengkapan ini, kami pasti bisa menutup kebutuhan mendesak Commander.

column1: And Miss Nele, thank you for providing these high-value supplies free of charge, even though your own project is in urgent need of them...
column2: Dan Miss Nele, terima kasih sudah menyediakan pasokan bernilai tinggi ini secara cuma-cuma, padahal proyekmu sendiri sangat membutuhkannya...

column1: Compared to everything the Commander has done for us, these supplies are nothing.
column2: Dibanding semua yang sudah Commander lakukan untuk kami, pasokan ini bukan apa-apa.

column1: Thank you.
column2: Terima kasih.

column1: Sorry, Miss Nele, regarding the matter you commissioned... I can only give you a formal plan after all this turmoil is over.
column2: Maaf, Miss Nele, soal urusan yang kau titipkan... aku baru bisa memberimu rencana resmi setelah semua kekacauan ini selesai.

column1: It's okay, I'll wait for you.
column2: Tidak apa-apa, aku akan menunggumu.

column1: Also, the Commander too. So all of you... must return safely!
column2: Dan Commander juga. Jadi kalian semua... harus kembali dengan selamat!

column1: I will also speed up the progress in the rear and get Alva back to the frontline as soon as possible.
column2: Aku juga akan mempercepat kemajuan di belakang dan mengembalikan Alva ke garis depan secepat mungkin.

column1: Yeah. Then we're heading out.
column2: Iya. Kalau begitu kami berangkat.

column1: (Kalina's communication was cut off, and this encrypted frequency band was abolished. This is a kind of protection for 16Lab, and also to ensure that all actions are as covert as possible.)
column2: (Komunikasi Kalina diputus, dan pita frekuensi terenkripsi itu dihapus. Ini semacam perlindungan untuk 16Lab, sekaligus memastikan semua gerakan sesembunyi mungkin.)

column1: Lainie, contact the administrator with the ID Caramel Hazelnut Coffee on your anonymous board.
column2: Lainie, hubungi administrator dengan ID Caramel Hazelnut Coffee di papan anonim kalian.

column1: Have her erase any traces related to Kalina and provide them with as much cover as possible.
column2: Suruh dia menghapus semua jejak terkait Kalina dan memberi mereka perlindungan sebanyak mungkin.

column1: Caramel Hazelnut Coffee... Is this one also a Griffin Doll...?
column2: Caramel Hazelnut Coffee... yang ini juga Doll Griffin...?

column1: As long as you know she's an ally, that's enough. She'll handle it.
column2: Cukup tahu dia sekutu, itu saja. Dia yang akan mengurusnya.

column1: Persica, is it really okay for us to do this?
column2: Persica, ini benar-benar tidak masalah kita lakukan?

column1: There's no 'okay' or 'not okay'. 16Lab is a completely independently operated organization. Moreover, what we're sending out this time are just some 'backlogged and hoarded scrap materials' and Doll frames 'eliminated' during experiments.
column2: Tidak ada 'masalah' atau 'tidak masalah'. 16Lab organisasi yang beroperasi sepenuhnya mandiri. Lagi pula yang kita kirim kali ini cuma 'material rongsok yang menumpuk dan tertimbun' dan frame Doll yang 'disingkirkan' saat eksperimen.

column1: Even if the URNC sends someone to investigate later, they won't be able to find any faults.
column2: Meski URNC nanti mengirim orang untuk menyelidiki, mereka tidak akan menemukan satu kesalahan pun.

column1: Or is it, Leibnys, that you want to send him more private assistance?
column2: Atau jangan-jangan, Leibnys, kau mau mengirimkan bantuan pribadi yang lebih banyak untuknya?

column1: I just don't want the precious technologies he possesses to disappear in the flames of war.
column2: Aku hanya tidak ingin teknologi berharga yang dia miliki hilang dalam kobaran perang.

column1: Not to mention we've all been cooperating for so long...
column2: Apalagi kita semua sudah lama bekerja sama...

column1: Judging from the intelligence Miss Nele brought... the number of enemies surrounding Mokosh is simply too high, and they all have regular army-level firepower.
column2: Dilihat dari intel yang dibawa Miss Nele... jumlah musuh yang mengepung Mokosh terlalu banyak, dan semuanya punya daya tembak setingkat tentara reguler.

column1: Persica, aren't you worried at all?
column2: Persica, kau sama sekali tidak khawatir?

column1: ...What do I have to worry about. As you said, we've been working together for so long. I know exactly how tough that person's life is.
column2: ...Apa yang perlu kukhawatirkan. Seperti katamu, kita sudah lama bekerja sama. Aku tahu persis betapa alot nyawa orang itu.

column1: (Persica picks up the mug on the table and takes a small sip of the coffee inside. The next second, her brows instantly twist into a tight knot.)
column2: (Persica mengambil cangkir di meja dan menyesap sedikit kopinya. Sedetik kemudian dahinya seketika berkerut rapat.)

column1: What's wrong with the coffee today? You didn't put any sugar in it at all, did you...
column2: Kopinya hari ini kenapa? Kau sama sekali tidak menambahkan gula, ya...

column1: Huh? That's impossible. I strictly followed your request and put in exactly three more Sugar Cubes than usual... Ugh...
column2: Hah? Mustahil. Aku mengikuti permintaanmu dengan ketat dan menambahkan tepat tiga Sugar Cube lebih banyak dari biasanya... Ugh...

column1: I remember reminding you that there are strict regulations on your daily sugar intake, right?
column2: Kalau tidak salah aku pernah mengingatkanmu bahwa asupan gula harianmu punya aturan yang ketat, kan?

column1: Hehehe, it seems you are still very worried about the Commander.
column2: Hehehe, sepertinya kau tetap sangat mengkhawatirkan Commander.

column1: Every time someone I didn't want to die... they ended up leaving.
column2: Setiap kali ada yang tidak kuinginkan mati... mereka akhirnya pergi juga.

column1: ...This world needs people like him to survive.
column2: ...Dunia ini butuh orang seperti dia untuk bertahan hidup.

column1: And only if he survives, Nele, will this stack of proposals of yours show their true value.
column2: Dan hanya kalau dia bertahan hidup, Nele, tumpukan proposalmu itu akan menunjukkan nilai sesungguhnya.

column1: You're right...
column2: Kau benar...

column1: (Nele looked down at her arms, tightly hugging a thick proposal.)
column2: (Nele menunduk menatap pelukannya, mendekap erat sebuah proposal yang tebal.)

column1: (The thick stack of papers was printed with the preliminary concept for a non-profit humanitarian relief organization. This was a 'gift' she had poured all her heart and soul into, preparing to give it to the Commander.)
column2: (Tumpukan kertas tebal itu bercetak konsep awal sebuah organisasi bantuan kemanusiaan nirlaba. Itu 'hadiah' yang dia curahkan dengan sepenuh hati, disiapkan untuk diberikan kepada Commander.)

column1: A project proposal for a humanitarian relief organization, and even the operational authority... You're basically planning to hand over your entire fortune to him.
column2: Proposal proyek organisasi bantuan kemanusiaan, bahkan wewenang operasionalnya... Kau pada dasarnya berniat menyerahkan seluruh kekayaanmu padanya.

column1: Because I know very well that if I were to take the lead on this... it would be impossible to have the same appeal and cohesion as the Commander.
column2: Karena aku sangat tahu kalau aku yang memimpin ini... mustahil punya daya tarik dan daya rekat yang sama dengan Commander.

column1: Whether it's his past identity as a hero, or what he can achieve in the Yellow Zone now...
column2: Baik identitas masa lalunya sebagai pahlawan, maupun apa yang bisa dia capai di Yellow Zone sekarang...

column1: I believe that entrusting this power to the Commander can bring more hope to this world.
column2: Aku percaya menyerahkan kekuatan ini kepada Commander bisa membawa lebih banyak harapan bagi dunia ini.

column1: A very pure, and very good idea.
column2: Gagasan yang sangat murni, dan sangat baik.

column1: Leibnys, after hearing this, are you interested in jumping ship and checking it out over there?
column2: Leibnys, setelah mendengar ini, kau tertarik pindah kapal dan melihat-lihat ke sana?

column1: Although it sounds very appealing, currently your research, Persica, is still more attractive to me.
column2: Meski kedengarannya sangat menarik, sekarang risetmu, Persica, masih lebih menarik bagiku.

column1: Besides, only with me here can I guarantee the time and space for you to focus on your research, and ensure your physical health, Persica.
column2: Lagi pula hanya dengan aku di sini aku bisa menjamin waktu dan ruang bagimu untuk fokus pada risetmu, dan menjaga kesehatan fisikmu, Persica.

column1: Especially when it comes to sugar intake.
column2: Terutama soal asupan gula.

column1: What a pity. I thought we could take it easy for a while.
column2: Sayang sekali. Kupikir kita bisa santai sebentar.

column1: (Beep beep beep beep beep beep beep—)
column2: (Tit tit tit tit tit tit tit—)

column1: (A sharp emergency communication tone suddenly blared in the laboratory, interrupting their conversation. An unknown frequency band with multiple layers of encryption popped up on the screen.)
column2: (Nada komunikasi darurat yang tajam tiba-tiba menyalak di laboratorium, memotong percakapan mereka. Sebuah pita frekuensi tak dikenal dengan enkripsi berlapis muncul di layar.)

column1: Top-level encrypted communication? Who could it be at a time like this...
column2: Komunikasi terenkripsi tingkat tertinggi? Siapa lagi di saat seperti ini...

column1: This is truly a rare guest to see.
column2: Ini benar-benar tamu yang langka.

column1: Kalina has already set out, bringing all the supplies we provided.
column2: Kalina sudah berangkat, membawa semua pasokan yang kami sediakan.

column1: I know... let her go. She has grown to the point where she can hold her own.
column2: Aku tahu... biarkan dia pergi. Dia sudah tumbuh sampai bisa berdiri sendiri.

column1: I'm taking a risk to contact you because of something else.
column2: Aku mengambil risiko menghubungimu karena hal lain.

column1: I need you to help me send some people away, ensuring they can leave the Green Zone while avoiding URNC surveillance.
column2: Aku butuh kau membantuku mengirim beberapa orang keluar, memastikan mereka bisa meninggalkan Green Zone sambil menghindari pengawasan URNC.

column1: ...You really are prone to disasters.
column2: ...Kau memang gampang kena bencana.

column1: I understand, Lainie will be responsible for the reception. However, the window period during which we can forcibly forge signals for cover... hmm...
column2: Aku paham, Lainie yang akan mengurus penerimaannya. Namun jendela waktu saat kami bisa memalsukan sinyal secara paksa untuk perlindungan... hmm...

column1: 3 hours, that's the limit.
column2: 3 jam, itu batasnya.

column1: You heard her. We'll wait for your signal.
column2: Kau dengar sendiri. Kami akan menunggu sinyalmu.

column1: Mhm, thank you, Persica.
column2: Mhm, terima kasih, Persica.

column1: (Without any extra pleasantries, after a brief conversation, the communication is forcibly cut off by the other side with extreme caution.)
column2: (Tanpa basa-basi tambahan, setelah percakapan singkat, komunikasinya diputus paksa oleh pihak sana dengan kehati-hatian yang ekstrem.)

column1: Is Mr. Kryuger alright? I always feel like things on his end are also...
column2: Mr. Kryuger baik-baik saja? Aku selalu merasa keadaan di pihaknya juga...

column1: With his current sensitive position, it's impossible for him to actively step forward in public. Looking at his situation, he's probably been invited to 'drink tea' and put under house arrest somewhere by those URNC politicians again.
column2: Dengan posisinya yang sensitif sekarang, mustahil dia maju secara terbuka. Melihat keadaannya, dia mungkin kembali 'diajak minum teh' dan ditahan di suatu tempat oleh politikus URNC itu.

column1: Lainie, I'll leave the follow-up here to you. You have Leva's memories, you should know how to handle it.
column2: Lainie, tindak lanjut di sini kuserahkan padamu. Kau punya ingatan Leva, kau seharusnya tahu cara menanganinya.

column1: There should be other people related to the Commander contacting us later. It seems leaving you behind was the right choice.
column2: Seharusnya nanti ada orang lain yang berkaitan dengan Commander menghubungi kita. Sepertinya menahanmu di sini pilihan yang tepat.

column1: Understood! Leave it to me.
column2: Dimengerti! Serahkan padaku.

column1: I'll help deal with it too... Hmm?
column2: Aku juga akan ikut membantu... Hmm?

column1: (An urgent communication tone rang out, and this time it wasn't the 16Lab dedicated line. It rang from Persica's pocket.)
column2: (Nada komunikasi mendesak berbunyi, dan kali ini bukan jalur khusus 16Lab. Bunyinya datang dari saku Persica.)

column1: It's really lively today... Oh?
column2: Hari ini ramai sekali... Oh?

column1: Persica. Is it safe now.
column2: Persica. Sekarang aman?

column1: Very safe.
column2: Sangat aman.

column1: Long time no see, ST AR-15. If you had contacted us a bit earlier, you could have spoken with Soppo and Robella.
column2: Lama tidak bertemu, ST AR-15. Kalau kau menghubungi sedikit lebih awal, kau bisa bicara dengan Soppo dan Robella.

column1: Did they... go look for the Commander?
column2: Apa mereka... pergi mencari Commander?

column1: They set off with Kalina. Do you need me to give you their current temporary contact info?
column2: Mereka berangkat bersama Kalina. Perlu kuberikan info kontak sementara mereka sekarang?

column1: ...No, now is not the time to catch up.
column2: ...Tidak, sekarang bukan waktunya bernostalgia.

column1: Persica, I conducted an in-depth investigation of Paradeus's abandoned laboratory.
column2: Persica, aku melakukan penyelidikan mendalam di laboratorium Paradeus yang terbengkalai.

column1: In the laboratory, I encountered that "special Doll" you mentioned before... and that person named Chiloveig.
column2: Di laboratorium itu aku berhadapan dengan "Doll khusus" yang kau sebut dulu... dan orang bernama Chiloveig.

column1: Ateraxis and Chiloveig?! Why would they be acting together?!
column2: Ateraxis dan Chiloveig?! Kenapa mereka bergerak bersama?!

column1: Tell me, what kind of support do you need me to provide this time?
column2: Katakan, dukungan apa yang kau butuhkan dariku kali ini?

column1: Vehicles, ammo supplies... including the share for M16 and the others.
column2: Kendaraan, pasokan amunisi... termasuk bagian untuk M16 dan yang lain.

column1: It seems you've already secretly contacted her. Has your relationship eased up a bit?
column2: Sepertinya kau sudah diam-diam menghubunginya. Hubungan kalian sudah agak melunak?

column1: ...That has nothing to do with the mission.
column2: ...Itu tidak ada kaitannya dengan misi.

column1: By the way, I also have a convenient matter here that I need you to handle on your way.
column2: Ngomong-ngomong, aku juga punya urusan yang kebetulan searah dan perlu kau tangani di perjalanan.

column1: To be precise, someone 'specifically requested' you to go.
column2: Lebih tepatnya, ada yang 'secara khusus meminta' kau yang pergi.

column1: Calling me out by name at a critical juncture like this... it must be some troublesome person related to the Commander.
column2: Menyebut namaku di titik krusial seperti ini... pasti orang menyusahkan yang berkaitan dengan Commander.

column1: Hehe, she just finished a long 'vacation' and now needs someone trustworthy to receive her.
column2: Hehe, dia baru menyelesaikan 'liburan' yang panjang dan sekarang butuh orang yang bisa dipercaya untuk menjemputnya.

column1: I will send you the specific location coordinates and information using other encryption methods.
column2: Aku akan mengirimkan koordinat lokasi dan informasi spesifiknya lewat metode enkripsi lain.

column1: I'll leave the Commander to you. I look forward to the moment your AR Team reunites.
column2: Commander kuserahkan padamu. Aku menantikan momen AR Team kalian berkumpul kembali.

column1: The AR Team... missing even a single person cannot be called a 'reunion'.
column2: AR Team... kurang satu orang saja tidak bisa disebut 'berkumpul kembali'.

column1: But I firmly believe that one day, we will stand before the Commander without a single one missing.
column2: Tapi aku yakin sepenuhnya suatu hari kami akan berdiri di depan Commander tanpa kurang satu pun.

column1: (The static of the communication abruptly stops as Asteria unilaterally closes the connection.)
column2: (Derau komunikasinya berhenti mendadak saat Asteria menutup sambungannya secara sepihak.)

column1: (Listening to her resolute declaration without a trace of hesitation, the corners of Persica's mouth finally uncontrollably curl into a gratified smile.)
column2: (Mendengar pernyataannya yang tegas tanpa setitik keraguan, sudut mulut Persica akhirnya melengkung tanpa bisa ditahan jadi senyum penuh syukur.)

column1: Persica? Is there some good news?
column2: Persica? Ada kabar baik?

column1: Seeing those children have all grown, I feel happy too.
column2: Melihat anak-anak itu semuanya sudah tumbuh, aku juga merasa senang.

column1: I just don't know where the Commander gets the charm to kidnap all these kids...
column2: Aku cuma tidak tahu dari mana Commander mendapat pesona untuk menculik anak-anak ini semua...

column1: (Persica picked up her coffee again and took a sip with a slight smile.)
column2: (Persica kembali mengambil kopinya dan menyesapnya dengan senyum tipis.)

column1: Even if it's for those who follow you, those idealists who want to walk the same path as you.
column2: Meski itu demi mereka yang mengikutimu, para idealis yang ingin menempuh jalan yang sama denganmu.

column1: You must overcome this predicament, {cmdr}.
column2: Kau harus melewati keadaan sulit ini, {cmdr}.

column1: I wish you luck.
column2: Semoga kau beruntung.
